Alex R: Follow-up from RFC: decision needed on whether app rollouts are intent-only or binding. We discussed earlier but need a concrete choice for API surface.

Maya T: Vote for intent-only. Platform should synthesize a safe plan (pct, assignments) and publish a seq-numbered decision. Apps get visibility but not unilateral authority.

Jon P: Agree. Proposal: POST /intents -> returns intent_id. Planner publishes plan: {plan_id, seq, assignments, effective_until}. Hosts accept plan only if seq>last_seq and now<effective_until.

Alex R: Hosts also need a local escape hatch for transient SLOs (e.g., p95 spike). Local fallback tokens TTL=30s, reason codes like SLOW_MODEL/CPU_STALL. Planner ignores isolated tokens but escalates if many hosts report same reason.

Maya T: Add hysteresis: local re-enable uses exponential backoff (5s -> 2m). Planner-level rollback requires N consecutive windows (default 3).

ops-bot: Planner applied plan 3067894321 at 2026-03-24T09:10Z (seq=5) :white_check_mark:

Jon P: Action items: Maya draft API schema & reason_code enum; I'll prototype host seq+ttl shim; Alex will update RFC with default numbers and RBAC notes.

Alex R: Good. We'll document compatibility for older agents and add audit/approval gates for large canaries.
